data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal, the GitHub lookup, and the email's To, Subject and Body right. But it leaves out the blog parameter and the separate tab visit that supplies the latest post title, wrongly treats the post as GitHub activity, adds a Users filter step, and ends with an ambiguous "Send or Discard" instead of never sending and always discarding, so an automation couldn't be built from it reliably.
